axis_report: Spec slice B passes criteria 7–13. Source comparison distinguishes matched, stale and unavailable evidence. Invalid records remain readable with warnings. Dependencies remain in the scrollable history, and workflow errors still disable worktree transitions. Changed-file counts come only from structured recorded fields. Stable event IDs and separate pane offsets retain selection through live insertion and detail return. Refresh failures retain readable history, clear current-source claims and expose a warning. Event text uses existing sanitization and Unicode-aware wrapping; explicit labels carry meaning without colour. I verified the pinned commit, tree, clean worktree and supplied diff hash with Git commands. I inspected the focused modal assertions but did not execute tests, the compiler or native Pi. Prior exact-source test and terminal observations support this assessment; the main reviewer owns fresh runtime verification. This verdict covers only the assigned criteria. It does not authorize integration or ticket completion.
